Group rides in Wisconsin

11 recurring group rides around Wisconsin: 7 road, 6 social, 1 cruiser. 10 roll on weeknights, 0 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Market to Music Ride in Green Bay — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Capital Brewery Bike Club Tuesday and Thursday Rides runs a: 20–25 mph, 20–35 mi. B: 16–20 mph, 20–30 mi. C: 12–16 mph, 18–28 mi (e-bikes welcome).
